test_gptq_marlin_gemm: test the gptq_marlin_gemm function with various quantization types, group sizes, and activation orders
run_gptq_marlin_gemm: run gptq_marlin_gemm kernel with float16 inputs, marlin quantized weights, and workspace for matrix multiplication
build_marlin_quantize: build marlin quantized weights from float16 input using awq_marlin_quantize with quantization type and group size
build_marlin_quantize_act_order: build marlin quantized weights with act_order support using marlin_quantize, returning quantized weight, scale, and sort indices
create_workspace_marlin: create a CUDA workspace buffer for marlin quantized matrix multiplication using marlin_make_workspace
